name: hou_mcp_shell_gate
description: Evaluate the environment readiness gate from a completed shell_json. Returns gate_passed (bool), gate_status (ENVIRONMENT_READY or ENVIRONMENT_NOT_READY), severity (OK or BLOCKING), and blocked_systems list. Wire exec_out_ready to FurnitureClusterBuilder and exec_out_blocked to an error handler.
python_code:
import json
from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.environment_shell import get_environment_readiness_gate, ENVIRONMENT_READY

class Hou_Mcp_Shell_Gate(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_shell_gate"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("shell_json",          "string", widget_type="text", default="{}")
        self.add_input("required_wall_count", "int",    widget_type="int",  default=4)
        self.add_output("gate_json")
        self.add_output("gate_passed",      "bool")
        self.add_output("gate_status")
        self.add_output("severity")
        self.add_output("blocked_systems")
        self.add_output("exec_out_ready",   "any")
        self.add_output("exec_out_blocked", "any")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        raw          = (inputs.get("shell_json") or "{}").strip()
        required     = int(inputs.get("required_wall_count") or 4)
        try:
            shell_dict = json.loads(raw)
        except Exception:
            shell_dict = {}

        try:
            gate = get_environment_readiness_gate().check_dict(shell_dict, required)
            gate_passed = gate.gate_passed
            return {
                "gate_json":       json.dumps(gate.to_dict(), sort_keys=True, indent=2),
                "gate_passed":     gate_passed,
                "gate_status":     gate.gate_status,
                "severity":        gate.severity,
                "blocked_systems": json.dumps(gate.blocked_systems),
                "exec_out_ready":  True if gate_passed else None,
                "exec_out_blocked": None if gate_passed else True,
                "exec_out":        True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"hou_mcp_shell_gate failed: {exc}")
            return {"gate_json": "{}", "gate_passed": False, "gate_status": "ENVIRONMENT_NOT_READY", "severity": "BLOCKING", "blocked_systems": "[]", "exec_out_ready": None, "exec_out_blocked": True, "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Shell_Gate
